name: residence-tour-build
description: Bundles tour/js/tour.js and tour/js/plan.js (three.js) into tour/js/*.bundle.js so the pages work from file://.

scripts.build: NODE_PATH=./node_modules esbuild ../js/tour.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=../js/tour.bundle.js --legal-comments=none && NODE_PATH=./node_modules esbuild ../js/plan.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=../js/plan.bundle.js --legal-comments=none && node stamp.mjs
